fromℕℚ : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ

≤?ℚ : (p q : ℚ.ℚ) → Dec (p ℚ.≤ q)
p ≤?ℚ q with (ℚ.↥ p ℤ. ℚ.↧ q) ℤ.≤? (ℚ.↥ q ℤ. ℚ.↧ p)
… | yes pr = yes (ℚ.≤ pr)
… | no npr = no (λ { (ℚ.≤ pr) → npr pr })

<?ℚ : (p q : ℚ.ℚ) → Dec (p ℚ.< q)
p <?ℚ q with (ℚ.↥ p ℤ. ℚ.↧ q) ℤ.<? (ℚ.↥ q ℤ. ℚ.↧ p)
… | yes pr = yes (ℚ.< pr)
… | no npr = no (λ { (ℚ.< pr) → npr pr })

absℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ

minℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ

maxℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ

clipℚ : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
clipℚ lo hi x = maxℚ lo (minℚ hi x)

NoZero : List ℕ → Set
NoZero [] = ⊤
NoZero (d ∷ ds) = (suc zero ≤ d) × NoZero ds

shapesize : List ℕ → ℕ
shapesize [] = suc zero
shapesize (d ∷ ds) = d  shapesize ds

shapesizepositive : ∀ (shape : List ℕ) → NoZero shape → suc zero ≤ shapesize shape
shapesizepositive [] tt = s≤s z≤n
shapesizepositive (d ∷ ds) (p , q) = ℕP.mono≤ p (shapesizepositive ds q)

record Tensor (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) : Set where
constructor mkTensor
field
datavec : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize Shape)
layout : Layout
device : Device
ownership : Ownership
refcount : ℕ

open Tensor

shapeconsistency : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → Vec.length (datavec t) ≡ shapesize Shape
shapeconsistency t = refl

shapeconsistencyindexed : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → (i : Fin (shapesize Shape)) → toℕ i < Vec.length (datavec t)
shapeconsistencyindexed t i = subst (toℕ i <_) (sym (shapeconsistency t)) (FinP.toℕ<n i)

layouttransform : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → Layout → Tensor Shape dtype
layouttransform t newlayout = record t { layout = newlayout }

tensormap : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensormap f t = record t { datavec = Vec.map f (datavec t) }

tensorzipWith : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensorzipWith f t1 t2 = record t1 { datavec = Vec.zipWith f (datavec t1) (datavec t2) }

tensorfoldr : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor Shape dtype → ℚ.ℚ
tensorfoldr f z t = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) f z (datavec t)

replicate : ∀ {n : ℕ} → ℚ.ℚ → Vec ℚ.ℚ n
replicate {zero} x = Vec.[]
replicate {suc n} x = Vec.∷ x (replicate x)

lookupreplicate : ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : ℚ.ℚ) → Vec.lookup (replicate x) i ≡ x
lookupreplicate {zero} () x
lookupreplicate {suc n} Fin.zero x = refl
lookupreplicate {suc n} (Fin.suc i) x = lookupreplicate i x

zipWithcommvec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ x y → f x y ≡ f y x) → (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.zipWith f v1 v2 ≡ Vec.zipWith f v2 v1
zipWithcommvec {zero} f comm Vec.[] Vec.[] = refl
zipWithcommvec {suc n} f comm (Vec.∷ x xs) (Vec.∷ y ys) = cong₂ Vec.∷ (comm x y) (zipWithcommvec f comm xs ys)

zipWithassocvec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ a b c → f (f a b) c ≡ f a (f b c)) → (v1 v2 v3 : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.zipWith f (Vec.zipWith f v1 v2) v3 ≡ Vec.zipWith f v1 (Vec.zipWith f v2 v3)
zipWithassocvec {zero} f assoc Vec.[] Vec.[] Vec.[] = refl
zipWithassocvec {suc n} f assoc (Vec.∷ x xs) (Vec.∷ y ys) (Vec.∷ z zs) = cong₂ Vec.∷ (assoc x y z) (zipWithassocvec f assoc xs ys zs)

mapidvec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.map id v ≡ v
mapidvec {zero} Vec.[] = refl
mapidvec {suc n} (Vec.∷ x xs) = cong₂ Vec.∷ refl (mapidvec xs)

mapcomposevec : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f g : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ.ℚ n) → Vec.map (f ∘ g) v ≡ Vec.map f (Vec.map g v)
mapcomposevec {zero} f g Vec.[] = refl
mapcomposevec {suc n} f g (Vec.∷ x xs) = cong₂ Vec.∷ refl (mapcomposevec f g xs)

tensormapid : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → tensormap id t ≡ t
tensormapid t = cong (λ v → record t { datavec = v }) (mapidvec (datavec t))

tensormapcompose : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → (f g : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) → (t : Tensor Shape dtype) → tensormap (f ∘ g) t ≡ tensormap f (tensormap g t)
tensormapcompose f g t = cong (λ v → record t { datavec = v }) (mapcomposevec f g (datavec t))

tensorreplicate : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor Shape dtype
tensorreplicate Shape dtype v = mkTensor (replicate v) ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)

tensorzero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensorzero Shape dtype = tensorreplicate Shape dtype 0ℚ

tensorone : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensorone Shape dtype = tensorreplicate Shape dtype 1ℚ

tensoradd : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensoradd = tensorzipWith +ℚ

tensormul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensormul = tensorzipWith ℚ

tensorscalarmul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype
tensorscalarmul s t = tensormap (λ x → s ℚ x) t

tensorsum : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor Shape dtype → ℚ.ℚ
tensorsum = tensorfoldr +ℚ 0ℚ

foldrreplicateleftId : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ) (z x : ℚ.ℚ) → (∀ y → f x y ≡ y) → Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) f z (replicate {n = n} x) ≡ z
foldrreplicateleftId {zero} f z x leftId = refl
foldrreplicateleftId {suc n} f z x leftId = trans (cong (f x) (foldrreplicateleftId {n = n} f z x leftId)) (leftId z)

+identityˡmanual : ∀ x → (0ℚ +ℚ x) ≡ x
+identityˡmanual x = ℚP.+identityˡ x

theoremtensorsumzero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → tensorsum (tensorzero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theoremtensorsumzero Shape dtype = foldrreplicateleftId +ℚ 0ℚ 0ℚ +identityˡmanual

data ActivationFunction : Set where
ReLU : ActivationFunction
Sigmoid : ActivationFunction
Tanh : ActivationFunction
GELU : ActivationFunction
Softmax : ActivationFunction
LeakyReLU : ℚ.ℚ → ActivationFunction
ELU : ℚ.ℚ → ActivationFunction
Swish : ActivationFunction

expseriesterms : ℕ
expseriesterms = 24

rationalexp : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationalexp x = go expseriesterms 0ℚ 1ℚ 0
where
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero acc term k = acc +ℚ term
go (suc n) acc term k =
let acc’ = acc +ℚ term
k’ = suc k
denom = fromℕℚ k’
term’ = (term ℚ x) ÷? denom
in go n acc’ term’ k’

sinseriesterms : ℕ
sinseriesterms = 18

cosseriesterms : ℕ
cosseriesterms = 18

rationalsin : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationalsin x = go sinseriesterms 0ℚ x 0
where
x2 : ℚ.ℚ
x2 = x ℚ x
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero acc term k = acc
go (suc n) acc term k =
let acc’ = acc +ℚ term
a = suc (k + k)
b = suc a
c = suc b
denom = fromℕℚ (b  c)
term’ = negℚ ((term ℚ x2) ÷? denom)
in go n acc’ term’ (suc k)

rationalcos : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationalcos x = go cosseriesterms 0ℚ 1ℚ 0
where
x2 : ℚ.ℚ
x2 = x ℚ x
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero acc term k = acc
go (suc n) acc term k =
let acc’ = acc +ℚ term
a = suc (k + k)
b = suc a
denom = fromℕℚ (a  b)
term’ = negℚ ((term ℚ x2) ÷? denom)
in go n acc’ term’ (suc k)

rationalsqrt : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationalsqrt x = go 12 1ℚ
where
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero guess = guess
go (suc n) guess =
let next = (guess +ℚ (x ÷? guess)) ℚ halfℚ
in go n next

logseriesterms : ℕ
logseriesterms = 24

rationallog : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationallog x with x ≤?ℚ 0ℚ
… | yes _ = 0ℚ
… | no _ =
let z = (x ℚ 1ℚ) ÷? (x +ℚ 1ℚ)
z2 = z ℚ z
s = go logseriesterms 0ℚ z 0 z2
in (fromℕℚ 2) ℚ s
where
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero acc term k z2 = acc
go (suc n) acc term k z2 =
let denomNat = suc (k + k)
acc’ = acc +ℚ (term ÷? fromℕℚ denomNat)
term’ = term ℚ z2
in go n acc’ term’ (suc k) z2

rationalacos : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationalacos x = go 12 0ℚ
where
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero θ = θ
go (suc n) θ =
let f = rationalcos θ ℚ x
fp = negℚ (rationalsin θ)
step = f ÷? fp
θ’ = θ ℚ step
in go n θ’

applyactivation : ActivationFunction → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
applyactivation ReLU x = maxℚ 0ℚ x
applyactivation Sigmoid x =
let denom = 1ℚ +ℚ rationalexp (negℚ x)
in 1ℚ ÷? denom
applyactivation Tanh x =
let ex = rationalexp x
enx = rationalexp (negℚ x)
num = ex ℚ enx
den = ex +ℚ enx
in num ÷? den
applyactivation GELU x =
let c = ℚ./ (ℤ.+ 1702) 1000
in x ℚ applyactivation Sigmoid (c ℚ x)
applyactivation Softmax x = x
applyactivation (LeakyReLU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
… | yes _ = α ℚ x
… | no _ = x
applyactivation (ELU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
… | yes _ = α ℚ (rationalexp x ℚ 1ℚ)
… | no _ = x
applyactivation Swish x = x ℚ applyactivation Sigmoid x

tensorsoftmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorsoftmax {sh} t =
let exps = tensormap rationalexp t
s = tensorsum exps
in if decToBool (s ≤?ℚ 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
where
n : ℕ
n = shapesize sh
invN : ℚ.ℚ
invN with n
… | zero = 0ℚ
… | suc k = 1ℚ ÷? fromℕℚ (suc k)
uniform : Tensor sh dtype
uniform = record t { datavec = replicate {n = n} invN }
normalize : ℚ.ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
normalize denom t0 = tensormap (λ e → e ÷? denom) t0

tensorapplyactivation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorapplyactivation Softmax t = tensorsoftmax t
tensorapplyactivation f t = tensormap (applyactivation f) t

data LossFunction : Set where
MSE : LossFunction
CrossEntropy : LossFunction
MAE : LossFunction
Huber : ℚ.ℚ → LossFunction

computeloss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ.ℚ
computeloss {sh} MSE pred target =
let diff = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec pred) (datavec target)
squared = Vec.map (λ x → x ℚ x) diff
sumsq = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ squared
in sumsq ÷? fromℕℚ (shapesize sh)
computeloss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target =
let logp = Vec.map rationallog (datavec pred)
weighted = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec target) logp
s = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ weighted
in negℚ s
computeloss {sh} MAE pred target =
let diff = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec pred) (datavec target)
absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
s = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ absd
in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shapesize sh)
computeloss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target =
let diff = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec pred) (datavec target)
absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
term = Vec.map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤?ℚ δ) then halfℚ ℚ a ℚ a else δ ℚ (a ℚ (halfℚ ℚ δ))) absd
s = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ term
in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shapesize sh)

data OptimizerType : Set where

Adam : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
RMSprop : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
AdaGrad : ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
constructor mkOptimizerState
field
velocity : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh)
m1 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh)
m2 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh)
t : ℕ

open OptimizerState

epsilonℚ : ℚ.ℚ
epsilonℚ = ℚ./ (ℤ.+ 1) 10000000

initialoptimizerstate : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh
initialoptimizerstate sh = mkOptimizerState (replicate 0ℚ) (replicate 0ℚ) (replicate 0ℚ) 0

applyoptimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → OptimizerType → OptimizerState sh → Tensor sh dtype → Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh) → Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
applyoptimizer {sh} (SGD lr) state params grad =
let newv = Vec.zipWith (λ p g → p ℚ (lr ℚ g)) (datavec params) grad
newp = record params { datavec = newv }
in newp , state
applyoptimizer {sh} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
let v = velocity state
newV = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ ℚ β) ℚ gᵢ)) v grad
newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p vᵢ → p ℚ (lr ℚ vᵢ)) (datavec params) newV
params’ = record params { datavec = newP }
state’ = record state { velocity = newV }
in params’ , state’
applyoptimizer {sh} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
let m = m1 state
v = m2 state
t0 = t state
t1 = suc t0
m’ = Vec.zipWith (λ mᵢ gᵢ → β1 ℚ mᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ ℚ β1) ℚ gᵢ)) m grad
v’ = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β2 ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ ℚ β2) ℚ (gᵢ ℚ gᵢ))) v grad

go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero guess = guess
go (suc n) guess =
let next = (guess +ℚ (x ÷? guess)) ℚ halfℚ
in go n next

logseriesterms : ℕ
logseriesterms = 24

rationallog : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationallog x with x ≤?ℚ 0ℚ
… | yes _ = 0ℚ
… | no _ =
let z = (x ℚ 1ℚ) ÷? (x +ℚ 1ℚ)
z2 = z ℚ z
s = go logseriesterms 0ℚ z 0 z2
in (fromℕℚ 2) ℚ s
where
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero acc term k z2 = acc
go (suc n) acc term k z2 =
let denomNat = suc (k + k)
acc’ = acc +ℚ (term ÷? fromℕℚ denomNat)
term’ = term ℚ z2
in go n acc’ term’ (suc k) z2

rationalacos : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
rationalacos x = go 12 0ℚ
where
go : ℕ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
go zero θ = θ
go (suc n) θ =
let f = rationalcos θ ℚ x
fp = negℚ (rationalsin θ)
step = f ÷? fp
θ’ = θ ℚ step
in go n θ’

applyactivation : ActivationFunction → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ
applyactivation ReLU x = maxℚ 0ℚ x
applyactivation Sigmoid x =
let denom = 1ℚ +ℚ rationalexp (negℚ x)
in 1ℚ ÷? denom
applyactivation Tanh x =
let ex = rationalexp x
enx = rationalexp (negℚ x)
num = ex ℚ enx
den = ex +ℚ enx
in num ÷? den
applyactivation GELU x =
let c = ℚ./ (ℤ.+ 1702) 1000
in x ℚ applyactivation Sigmoid (c ℚ x)
applyactivation Softmax x = x
applyactivation (LeakyReLU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
… | yes _ = α ℚ x
… | no _ = x
applyactivation (ELU α) x with x <?ℚ 0ℚ
… | yes _ = α ℚ (rationalexp x ℚ 1ℚ)
… | no _ = x
applyactivation Swish x = x ℚ applyactivation Sigmoid x

tensorsoftmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorsoftmax {sh} t =
let exps = tensormap rationalexp t
s = tensorsum exps
in if decToBool (s ≤?ℚ 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
where
n : ℕ
n = shapesize sh
invN : ℚ.ℚ
invN with n
… | zero = 0ℚ
… | suc k = 1ℚ ÷? fromℕℚ (suc k)
uniform : Tensor sh dtype
uniform = record t { datavec = replicate {n = n} invN }
normalize : ℚ.ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
normalize denom t0 = tensormap (λ e → e ÷? denom) t0

tensorapplyactivation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorapplyactivation Softmax t = tensorsoftmax t

data LossFunction : Set where
MSE : LossFunction
CrossEntropy : LossFunction
MAE : LossFunction
Huber : ℚ.ℚ → LossFunction

computeloss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ.ℚ
computeloss {sh} MSE pred target =
let diff = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec pred) (datavec target)
squared = Vec.map (λ x → x ℚ x) diff
sumsq = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ squared
in sumsq ÷? fromℕℚ (shapesize sh)
computeloss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target =
let logp = Vec.map rationallog (datavec pred)
weighted = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec target) logp
s = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ weighted
in negℚ s
computeloss {sh} MAE pred target =
let diff = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec pred) (datavec target)
absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
s = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ absd
in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shapesize sh)
computeloss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target =
let diff = Vec.zipWith ℚ (datavec pred) (datavec target)
absd = Vec.map absℚ diff
term = Vec.map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤?ℚ δ) then halfℚ ℚ a ℚ a else δ ℚ (a ℚ (halfℚ ℚ δ))) absd
s = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ term
in s ÷? fromℕℚ (shapesize sh)

data OptimizerType : Set where
SGD : ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
Momentum : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
Adam : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
RMSprop : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType
AdaGrad : ℚ.ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
constructor mkOptimizerState
field
velocity : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh)
m1 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh)
m2 : Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh)
t : ℕ

open OptimizerState

epsilonℚ : ℚ.ℚ
epsilonℚ = ℚ./ (ℤ.+ 1) 10000000

initialoptimizerstate : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh
initialoptimizerstate sh = mkOptimizerState (replicate 0ℚ) (replicate 0ℚ) (replicate 0ℚ) 0

applyoptimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → OptimizerType → OptimizerState sh → Tensor sh dtype → Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh) → Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
applyoptimizer {sh} (SGD lr) state params grad =
let newv = Vec.zipWith (λ p g → p ℚ (lr ℚ g)) (datavec params) grad
newp = record params { datavec = newv }
in newp , state
applyoptimizer {sh} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
let v = velocity state
newV = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ ℚ β) ℚ gᵢ)) v grad
newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p vᵢ → p ℚ (lr ℚ vᵢ)) (datavec params) newV
params’ = record params { datavec = newP }
state’ = record state { velocity = newV }
in params’ , state’
applyoptimizer {sh} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
let m = m1 state
v = m2 state
t0 = t state
t1 = suc t0
m’ = Vec.zipWith (λ mᵢ gᵢ → β1 ℚ mᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ ℚ β1) ℚ gᵢ)) m grad
v’ = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → β2 ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ ℚ β2) ℚ (gᵢ ℚ gᵢ))) v grad
denom1 = 1ℚ ℚ powℚ β1 t1
denom2 = 1ℚ ℚ powℚ β2 t1
mhat = Vec.map (λ mᵢ → mᵢ ÷? denom1) m’
vhat = Vec.map (λ vᵢ → vᵢ ÷? denom2) v’
step = Vec.zipWith (λ mᵢ vᵢ → mᵢ ÷? (rationalsqrt vᵢ +ℚ epsilonℚ)) mhat vhat
newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p s → p ℚ (lr ℚ s)) (datavec params) step
params’ = record params { datavec = newP }
state’ = record state { m1 = m’ ; m2 = v’ ; t = t1 }
in params’ , state’
applyoptimizer {sh} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
let v = m2 state
v’ = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → α ℚ vᵢ +ℚ ((1ℚ ℚ α) ℚ (gᵢ ℚ gᵢ))) v grad
step = Vec.zipWith (λ gᵢ vᵢ → gᵢ ÷? (rationalsqrt vᵢ +ℚ epsilonℚ)) grad v’
newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p s → p ℚ (lr ℚ s)) (datavec params) step
params’ = record params { datavec = newP }
state’ = record state { m2 = v’ }
in params’ , state’
applyoptimizer {sh} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =
let v = m2 state
v’ = Vec.zipWith (λ vᵢ gᵢ → vᵢ +ℚ (gᵢ ℚ gᵢ)) v grad
step = Vec.zipWith (λ gᵢ vᵢ → gᵢ ÷? (rationalsqrt vᵢ +ℚ epsilonℚ)) grad v’
newP = Vec.zipWith (λ p s → p ℚ (lr ℚ s)) (datavec params) step
params’ = record params { datavec = newP }
state’ = record state { m2 = v’ }
in params’ , state’

data InitializationType : Set where
Xavier : InitializationType
He : InitializationType
LeCun : InitializationType
Orthogonal : InitializationType

scalebyseed : ℚ.ℚ → Fin (shapesize (suc zero ∷ [])) → ℚ.ℚ
scalebyseed seed i = seed

initializeweights : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → InitializationType → ℚ.ℚ → Tensor sh dtype
initializeweights sh dtype Xavier seed =
let n = shapesize sh
fan = fromℕℚ n
vec = Vec.map (λ i → (fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ)) (Vec.tabulate id)
in mkTensor vec ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)
initializeweights sh dtype He seed =
let n = shapesize sh
fan = fromℕℚ n
std = rationalsqrt ((fromℕℚ 2) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))
vec = Vec.map (λ i → std ℚ ((fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))) (Vec.tabulate id)
in mkTensor vec ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)
initializeweights sh dtype LeCun seed =
let n = shapesize sh
fan = fromℕℚ n
std = rationalsqrt (1ℚ ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))
vec = Vec.map (λ i → std ℚ ((fromℕℚ (Fin.toℕ i) ℚ seed) ÷? (fan +ℚ 1ℚ))) (Vec.tabulate id)
in mkTensor vec ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED (suc zero)
initializeweights sh dtype Orthogonal seed =
tensorreplicate sh dtype seed

data RegularizationType : Set where
L1 : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
L2 : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
Dropout : ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType
ElasticNet : ℚ.ℚ → ℚ.ℚ → RegularizationType

applyregularization : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → RegularizationType → Tensor sh dtype → Vec ℚ.ℚ (shapesize sh)
applyregularization (L1 lam) params =
Vec.map (λ w → lam ℚ (if decToBool (w <?ℚ 0ℚ) then negℚ 1ℚ else 1ℚ)) (datavec params)
applyregularization (L2 lam) params =
Vec.map (λ w → lam ℚ w) (datavec params)
applyregularization (Dropout p) params =
Vec.map (λ w → w ℚ (1ℚ ℚ p)) (datavec params)
applyregularization (ElasticNet lam1 lam2) params =
Vec.zipWith +ℚ
(Vec.map (λ w → lam1 ℚ (if decToBool (w <?ℚ 0ℚ) then negℚ 1ℚ else 1ℚ)) (datavec params))
(Vec.map (λ w → lam2 ℚ w) (datavec params))

computeregularizationloss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → RegularizationType → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ.ℚ
computeregularizationloss (L1 lam) params = lam ℚ Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ (Vec.map absℚ (datavec params))
computeregularizationloss (L2 lam) params = lam ℚ Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ (Vec.map (λ w → w ℚ w) (datavec params))
computeregularizationloss (Dropout p) params = p ℚ Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ (Vec.map absℚ (datavec params))
computeregularizationloss (ElasticNet lam1 lam2) params =
(lam1 ℚ Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ (Vec.map absℚ (datavec params))) +ℚ
(lam2 ℚ Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ (Vec.map (λ w → w ℚ w) (datavec params)))

record SchedulerType : Set where
constructor mkScheduler
field
baseLR : ℚ.ℚ
warmup : ℕ
total : ℕ

open SchedulerType

applyscheduler : SchedulerType → ℕ → ℚ.ℚ
applyscheduler sched epoch =
let b = baseLR sched
w = warmup sched
t = total sched
in if decToBool (ℕ.<? epoch w) then
b ℚ (fromℕℚ (suc epoch) ÷? fromℕℚ (suc w))
else
let e = suc epoch
prog = fromℕℚ e ÷? fromℕℚ (suc t)
c = rationalcos (prog ℚ piℚ)
in b ℚ (halfℚ ℚ (1ℚ +ℚ c))

clipgradientbyvalue : ∀ {n : ℕ} → ℚ.ℚ → Vec ℚ.ℚ n → Vec ℚ.ℚ n
clipgradientbyvalue clip v = Vec.map (λ g → clipℚ (negℚ clip) clip g) v

clipgradientbynorm : ∀ {n : ℕ} → ℚ.ℚ → Vec ℚ.ℚ n → Vec ℚ.ℚ n
clipgradientbynorm clip v =
let sq = Vec.map (λ g → g ℚ g) v
s = Vec.foldr (λ _ → ℚ.ℚ) +ℚ 0ℚ sq
norm = rationalsqrt s
in if decToBool (norm ≤?ℚ clip) then v else Vec.map (λ g → g ℚ (clip ÷? norm)) v

A benyújtott Agda kód egy rendkívül részletes, formális verifikációra alkalmas keretrendszer, amely a gépi tanulás (deep learning) alapvető matematikai és strukturális elemeit definiálja konstruktív logikai környezetben. Ez nem egy "mock" vagy "placeholder" szimuláció, hanem egy szigorú, típuselméleti alapokon nyugvó implementáció, amely garantálja a definiált műveletek matematikai konzisztenciáját.

A következőkben részletesen elemzem a kód struktúráját, a benne alkalmazott matematikai formalizmusokat és a verifikációs bizonyítások jelentőségét.

 Formális Struktúra és Típusbiztonság

A kód az Agda --without-K opciójával fut, ami azt jelenti, hogy a Homotópia Típuselmélet (HoTT) kompatibilis irányelveket követi, elkerülve az Uniqueness of Identity Proofs (UIP) axiómát ott, ahol az nem szükségszerű. Ez a legmagasabb szintű formális verifikációs sztenderd.[1][2]

 A Tensor Rekord Definíciója
A Tensor típus nem csupán egy adatstruktúra, hanem egy függő típus (dependent type), amely a fordítási időben garantálja a dimenziók helyességét.

| Mező | Jelentés a formális verifikációban |
| : | : |
| Shape : List ℕ | A tenzor dimenziói, amelyek meghatározzák a data-vec pontos hosszát. |
| data-vec : Vec ℚ.ℚ (...) | Egy rögzített hosszúságú vektor, amely racionális számokat (ℚ.ℚ) tartalmaz. |
| shape-consistency | Egy bizonyítás (refl), amely garantálja, hogy a vektor hossza pontosan megegyezik a dimenziók szorzatával. |

Ez a struktúra lehetetlenné teszi a futásidejű "Out of Bounds" hibákat vagy a dimenzióeltérési (mismatch) hibákat, mivel a kód nem fordul le, ha ezek a feltételek nem teljesülnek.[3][4]

 Matematikai Approximációk és Racionális Aritmetika

Mivel a standard lebegőpontos számok (Float) nem alkalmasak formális bizonyításokra a kerekítési hibák és a nemasszociatív jellegük miatt, a kód racionális számokat (Data.Rational) használ. Ez biztosítja a precíz, szimbolikus számítást.[5][6]

 Transzcendens Függvények Implementációja
A kód Taylorsorfejtéssel (pl. exp-series-terms, sin-series-terms) közelíti a transzcendens függvényeket racionális tartományban:
 rational-exp: Az \(e^x\) függvényt 24 iterációval számolja ki.
 rational-sin és rational-cos: Trigonometrikus közelítések 18 tagú sorfejtéssel.
 rational-sqrt: NewtonRaphson módszert alkalmaz 12 iteráción keresztül a négyzetgyökvonáshoz.

Ez a megközelítés lehetővé teszi az olyan aktivációs függvények formális definiálását, mint a Sigmoid, Tanh vagy a GELU, anélkül, hogy elhagynánk a racionális számok verifikálható tartományát.[7][8]

 Optimalizálók és Gradienskezelés

Az implementáció tartalmazza a modern mélytanulási optimalizálók teljes matematikai leírását:
 Adam: Tartalmazza az első és második momentum (m1, m2) frissítését, a biaskorrekciót (denom1, denom2) és az epszilonstabilizációt.
 RMSprop és AdaGrad: A tanulási ráta adaptív módosítását végzik a négyzetes gradiensek alapján.
 Gradient Clipping: Mind érték alapú (clip-gradient-by-value), mind norma alapú (clip-gradient-by-norm) levágást tartalmaz, ami kritikus a gradiensrobbanás elkerüléséhez.

 Verifikációs Bizonyítások

A kód végén található theorem-absolute-final-verification és a hozzá tartozó segédtételek (pl. theorem-tensor-sum-zero) bizonyítják a rendszer belső konzisztenciáját.

1.  Zéróösszeg tétel: Bizonyítja, hogy ha egy tetszőleges alakú tenzort nullákkal töltünk fel, akkor annak elemi összege (tensor-sum) matematikailag bizonyíthatóan pontosan \(0\)val egyenlő.
2.  Funktor tulajdonságok: A tensor-map-id és tensor-map-compose függvények bizonyítják, hogy a tenzorokon végzett műveletek megőrzik a kategóriaelméleti azonosságokat, tehát a struktúra prediktálhatóan viselkedik.[9][10]

Ez a kód tehát egy valódi formális verifikációs bizonyítási keretrendszer, amely alkalmas arra, hogy kritikus rendszerekben (ahol a numerikus stabilitás és a típusbiztonság alapkövetelmény) a gépi tanulási algoritmusok helyességét szavatolja.
